svg.text: OPTION 5 - GROUND FLOOR (phase 1): stair in its own band behind the hall, all sizes inside walls
2 bedrooms, living, kitchen-dining opening to the garden through a 6'6" passage that also serves the stair and bedroom 2. 3 toilets in the house.
ROAD / GATE (NORTH) on the left. Top edge = EAST neighbour house (our new 9" wall). Bottom edge = WEST apartment (existing wall). Right = BACK (existing wall).

Plot 106' x 21' (20' at back). East: 6" compound wall + 1'3" setback. West: 1' setback from the apartment wall. Outer walls 9", partitions 6". All room sizes are inside wall faces. Positions are feet from the front boundary.
west setback 1' from the apartment wall
NEEM TREE: trunk 3'6" from road, 7'6" from west,
leans in to ~8'. Slab above starts at 14'.
EXTERNAL STAIR: 4' wide, 21 risers x 6", 20 treads x 10" = 16'8" run, 7'4" to 24'
store under the upper part (x 18' to 24', headroom 6'5" to 10')
SEPTIC TANK below (6 ft x 4 ft 6 in)
main door, shoe rack, wash basin
L counter on east + front wall, table at the west
open to sky, kitchen garden, sit-out
covered walk 3'3" (bridge above), washing machine niche
windows on the east wall above the setback (sill 7')
Black squares = RCC columns in the side walls (7 per side). Beams span the 16'6". The hall above is a clean rectangle with no stair in it.
